title: Private Tour: Miami Nighttime Sightseeing
includes: Hotel, airport, and Port pickup and drop-off (local only)
Food and drinks, unless specified (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: See Miami’s dazzling nighttime cityscape and bustling night life during this 3-hour private night tour.  Our professional guide will take you through Miami after dark to view historical landmarks in Biscayne Bay, the Art Deco buildings of South Beach, mansions and celebrity-laden islands, and some of the city's tallest skyscrapers.  We will even let you customize the tour if there are specific places you would like to go or see.  All you have to do is ask your guide!  Our night tour is a really fun way to spend an evening in Miami!
